comments.author: Wen zhi
comments.body: might be a silly question, but with this sword having an 'effect' attribute, will the dura still go down as normal swords would? or will the dura only go down if the effect is used?

comments.author: Jafar
comments.body: it wont lose dura at sea even while sea battling but might lose dura when land battling

comments.author: Miyo
comments.body: it will lose durability at land battle, and at sea melle (aboardage) battle, so be carefull with it!
